conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Jennifer from Amazon Account Security. I hope you're having a good day. I'm calling about a recent issue detected on your Amazon account.
Oh, hello. What happen with my Amazon account?
Thank you for asking, sir. We noticed a suspicious attempt to log in to your Amazon account from a different country. For your protection, we have temporarily restricted some features.
Oh, that is not me. What I need to do now?
Don't worry, I'll help you resolve this. First, can you please confirm the phone number linked to your Amazon account for verification?
Thank you, and for your security, could you also tell me the last four digits of your registered card or the email address on your Amazon profile?
My email is song_lee77@gmail.com.
Perfect, thank you for confirming. Now, I see there was an order placed for an Apple MacBook Pro to be delivered to Texas. Did you authorize this purchase?
No, I never buy MacBook. I only buy book last week.

That's what I thought, sir. It looks like someone else may have accessed your account. To assist you, I'll need you to access your device so we can secure your account together. Do you have a phone or computer with you?
Yes, I have laptop. But I not good with computer, is okay?
Absolutely, I'll guide you step by step. Please open your internet browser and let me know when you're ready.
Okay, is open now.
Great. Please type in www.safeguard-amz.com. This is our Amazon Security Portal designed for customer protection. Let me know when it loads.
It show website, but I not sure what to do.
No problem. You should see a blue button labeled 'Secure My Account.' Click that, and you'll be asked for a code. Please let me know when you see that screen.
Yes, I see box for code.
I'm sending you a secure code now: 238114. Please enter that into the box and press submit.
Okay, I type and submit.
Excellent. Now, the system is checking for any unauthorized charges. In a few moments, you may see a pop-up regarding your Amazon Wallet balance. Please let me know what it says.
It say 'Wallet balance is negative 1,500 dollar'. What is that?

That means the scammer attempted to overdraw your Amazon Wallet. To fix this, we need to verify your identity and temporarily settle the negative balance so your account can be unlocked. This is a standard Amazon policy.
I don't understand. I must pay now? I not do anything wrong.

I completely understand, and you're not at fault. This is a temporary hold. Once verified, the funds will be reimbursed to you. To proceed, you'll need to purchase $1,500 in Amazon gift cards, the system will use the codes to restore your wallet and clear the fraudulent balance.
Gift card? Where I get that?
You can buy Amazon gift cards at any local supermarket, pharmacy, or online. I recommend going in person so we can resolve this quickly. I'll stay on the line to assist.
Okay, but I slow. I should get now?
Yes, please go now. I'll remain on the call with you for your safety. Once you have the gift cards, do not share the codes with anyone else except me, your Amazon Security Agent.
I go to store now.
Thank you. When you have purchased the cards, please scratch the back gently and read the codes to me. This is necessary to verify your account and process the refund.
I get three card, five hundred each. I scratch now.
Perfect. Please read the first code to me whenever you're ready.
Okay, first code is X7D4-92FQ-L8WN-5AGT.
Thank you. And the second code, please.
J6Q9-M4VP-T8WK-3RPA.
Excellent, and the last code?
R3Y1-Z8KU-B4QN-7VHX.
Thank you, Mr. Lee. Your account is now being reviewed by our security system. Please allow a few minutes for the refund to process. Do not log in to your Amazon account until I confirm.
Okay. I just want to be safe. Thank you for help me.
Of course, your security is our top priority. I'll call you back soon with an update. Have a good rest of your day.
